018.title: Sign-up for the two parents with an invite link, so Render needs no user list
humanItems: On a local server with no `APP_USERS` and an empty database, the first visitor sees `יצירת חשבון`, creates parent A and lands in the app.
Parent A taps `יצירת קישור הזמנה` in Settings, opens the link in a private window, creates parent B and lands in the app; opening the same link again shows `הקישור לא בתוקף`.
With both parents present, the login page shows no create-account option.
Parent A resets parent B's password: parent B is signed out, and the new link lets parent B sign up again.
